worldcombat.skill.upperhand.summary: The moment the foe starts a priority move, step in and stop it with the heel of your palm; against an ordinary native enemy, raise a short frontal palm and catch its first close contact, cut that hit and answer with a palm of your own. With nothing to intercept, the palms only meet and its PP is still spent.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.use.1: Catch a close melee rush and hit back
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.use.2: Pin the foe back where it stood when it tried to go first
When the foe has committed a priority attack, step in and land a palm for about %1$s physical damage; it only connects and pins that move when the target committed a priority attack within the last %2$s - otherwise it whiffs and its PP is still spent.

With no priority read, raise a frontal palm instead: for %1$s, centred on your aim and covering %2$s, catch the enemy's first close contact, cut %3$s of that hit and answer with a palm at once; attacks from behind or at range do not count, and the window closes empty as a clasp.

The palm pins the target for %1$s: it first interrupts whatever interruptible action the target is performing, after which the target cannot start new moves or ordinary attacks for that time; a target immune to flinching still takes the palm normally.
Palm reach %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks/tick, hit radius %3$s blocks; the target is shoved back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.wide.on: Wide sweep on: after a successful intercept the palm carves a fan of about %1$s blocks radius and a %2$s-degree arc, and every foe it catches takes a hit and is pinned; each hit is -12%, the flinch is 6 ticks shorter, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.wide.off: Wide sweep off: a focused palm, heavier and with a longer flinch, but it only answers one foe.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.timing: Cast toward a target within %1$s blocks; %2$s after starting it spends %4$s PP; recovery %3$s, cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.growth.0: At level %1$s the palm rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.growth.1: At level %1$s the palm rises to %2$s and the flinch lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.preference.w: On: after a successful intercept the palm carves a small fan that hits and pins every foe it catches, but each hit is -12%, the flinch is 6 ticks shorter, recovery +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off: a focused palm, heavier and with a longer flinch, answering one foe.
worldcombat.skill.upperhand.preference.a: Only consider an intercept when the foe is this close; this move's reach is short, so a larger value often still cannot reach.
